summary: prospect-sequence is a runx skill that researches an account through a governed, SSRF-guarded HTTP front over an explicit host allowlist, synthesizes an angle that cites every source it read, drafts a 3-touch outreach sequence, and emits a gated send_proposal performed by the send-as catalog skill. It is published to the hosted runx registry as epistemedeus/prospect-sequence@sha-9575d8e502fb, opened as a PR against runxhq/runx (#140), local-harness-green (2/2), and dogfooded post-publish from the official source https://api.runx.ai with a sealed receipt that passes runx verify.

observations.statement: Example Org — Their public site states: "Example Domain" (read from https://example.com/). For an ICP of "B2B teams with a public marketing site", the opening angle ties our value to Example Org's own stated focus above, referencing only facts read from the cited sources. Every claim below is traceable to a source_url; nothing about Example Org is asserted that was not read.
observations.detail: The angle cites every source it used; no account fact is asserted that was not read from a cited source.

steps.subject: Re: Quick thought on Example Org

observations.detail: Multi-touch (3) outreach sequence; each touch cites the source fact it leans on.

value.consent_basis: outbound prospecting against publicly stated focus; recipient may opt out at first touch
value.note: This skill only proposes. No message is sent. The send-as catalog skill performs the gated Effect after approval.

observations.detail: Gated proposed Effect: decision=proposed, requires_approval=true, performed_by=send-as. This skill never sends; the actual send is the send-as catalog skill's gated Effect.
Research uses allowlisted public hosts only; the SSRF guard refuses loopback/private/link-local/ULA/CGNAT/cloud-metadata targets.
